svg.font-family: Nimbus Sans, Liberation Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

text.tspan: – the token dose-response, inside the patch family

g.text: module: TOKEN_DROP = d on the patch tokens – a dose ladder INSIDE the patch family
the ladder never compares patch against cls, so the FEATURE cannot confound it
and the encoder's output is ALSO the JEPA target – a dropped token leaves both sides of the loss
the dose ladder – six rungs, and the two endpoints are already on record
every rung is feature = patch and every rung's objective is identical: only d changes
keep = max( 1 , round( P · ( 1 − d ) ) ) , P = 256
one keep-set per call, shared across the clip
train only: at plan time every arm still encodes all 256 tokens
green = below the 14.51° constant bound, crimson = at or above it
falsifier: CEM flat across the ladder while the angular error climbs
then orientation decodability is a fourth screened quantity that dies under intervention
